# requires: logging
#
# A record whose writer said nothing about itself reaches a receiving service.
# Hop 0 belongs to the writer, so the service puts an explicit unattributed
# hop 0 in front of its own stamp, marks the record, and keeps the line. Its
# stamp is then hop 1, the attestation about the writer, and the author can be
# found. A writer that did send a claim keeps it as hop 0, and a platform whose
# attester answered nothing still leaves hop 0 to the writer.
record R 0 bare
chain R
keys R
attest R so_peercred
chain R
read R logging.writer_claim
author R
relay R
disputed R
record C 0
attest C so_peercred
chain C
read C logging.writer_claim
record P 0 bare
attest P none
chain P
author P

# expect 1: ok schema=1 [LOG-R2]
# expect 2: ok - [LOG-I16]
# expect 3: ok - [LOG-I16]
# expect 5: ok 0:unclaimed:claimed 1:so_peercred:established [LOG-I16] [LOG-I1] [LOG-I6]
# expect 6: ok type=string value=absent [LOG-I16] [LOG-I9]
# expect 7: ok by=so_peercred hop=1 [LOG-I7] [LOG-I16]
# expect 8: ok by=so_peercred hop=1 [LOG-I8]
# expect 9: ok disputed=no [LOG-I10]
# expect 12: ok 0:self:claimed 1:so_peercred:established [LOG-I4] [LOG-I16]
# expect 13: no-answer absent [LOG-I16]
# expect 16: ok 0:unclaimed:claimed [LOG-I12] [LOG-I16]
# expect 17: no-answer unattributed [LOG-I9]
